dcterms:description: TRIVIAQA is a large scale dataset containing question-answer pairs along with documents that contain the answers. It is designed for reading comprehension tasks, particularly focusing on complex questions over long documents.
dcterms:title: TRIVIAQA

dcterms:description: TRIVIAQA-NOP is a variant of the TRIVIAQA dataset where the preface section has been removed from each document to reduce bias towards answers appearing at the beginning of the document.
dcterms:title: TRIVIAQA-NOP
